title: PayBack Core
description: A plugin where death makes you weaker and you must repay your debt through PvP or quests
body:
**Payback Core**

_Payback Core is a plugin that introduces a death debt system, making survival more challenging, intense, and engaging._

Every death has consequences. When a player dies, they gain “debt” that applies debuffs. The more deaths, the weaker the player becomes.

**To remove debt, players must:**

kill other players
complete quests

_This creates a balance between risk and recovery, while encouraging PvP and adding meaningful progression._

**Features**
Death debt system (up to 6 levels)
Scaling debuffs based on deaths
Debt removal through PvP
Quest system with multiple difficulty levels
Quest cooldown based on online playtime
Anti-abuse PvP protection
Player data saving
Quests

**Use the command:**

/quest

**_The player receives a random quest._**

**Quest types:**

_Easy — removes 1 debt
Medium — removes 1 debt
Hard — removes 2 debt_
Players with higher debt have a higher chance of receiving easier quests.

**Quests:**

_have a cooldown
refresh every 45 minutes of online playtime
PvP System
Killing a player removes 1 debt
If the killer has no debt, nothing happens
The killed player gains +1 debt_

The same player can only count once within a certain time period (anti-abuse system).

**Commands**
/quest

_Get a random quest_

/cdeath

**View player statistics:**

_deaths
kills
completed quests
current debt level
Data Saving_

**All player data is automatically saved:**

_deaths
kills
quests
current debt_

**Progress is NOT lost after leaving the server.**

**Best For**
**_SMP servers
private servers with friends
hardcore survival setups
PvP-focused gameplay_**
